business_problem: Claibe addresses these challenges by transforming advanced visual AI into an intuitive, structured workspace for professional teams. However, Claibe's early experimentation with third-party AI tools presented issues with workflow control, repeatability, and commercial fit.
solution_summary: Claibe uses Gemini models and Google AI Studio to simplify professional image production for global design teams. Claibe addresses these challenges by transforming advanced visual AI into an intuitive, structured workspace for professional teams. Building with Google AI Studio gave Claibe the reliable model performance and strict data privacy it required, while Gemini models easily understood complex spatial relationships and lighting variables. This allowed Claibe to build a highly reliable workflow layer that translates professionals’ ideas into predictable, production-ready images. Inside the software, a customer assistant built on Gemini has transformed how professionals navigate creative roadblocks.
